title: A Letter for the Inheritance
author: Cyrus Ishikawa
blurb: Yara Okafor, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
